base: PR #131 head plus the queue-ordered handoff from the #54 branch
scope: Immutable plan replacement through RenderController with sample-accurate activation, state mapping, generations and acknowledged retirement
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none

thread-sanitizer.note: Local -fsanitize=thread build of plan-replacement-tests with engine.cpp, three runs, no reports

verified_behaviors: Replacement due at frame 1000 gives identical output for blocks 1/64/257/512/3000; a queued launch on a deleted track is dropped and a queued stop is remapped
Offers refused for null, changed rate or tempo, uncovered tracks or clips, shared or out-of-range targets and an invalid plan; one offer in flight; retirement must be collected first
Controls submitted before an offer use the old plan; controls after it wait behind the queued marker and use the new plan; a full queue refuses the offer; a stopped transport activates at once

Held MIDI voices continue under a new waveform with an exact saw value; passed notes do not retrigger and the next note starts; a removed clip stops its voices; a shortened release ends without dividing by zero

2000 threaded replacements with 400 refused offers; each retired plan is overwritten with NaN and destroyed on the control thread with no NaN in output; shutdown with an unactivated offer is freed by the destructor (LeakSanitizer in sanitizer presets)
Zero C++ allocations and deallocations intercepted on the render thread during replace and render
planMapping maps tracks and clips by ID across a deletion and the engine continues the surviving track at the same position
Mutations caught: retiring the active plan aborts with a double free; leaving the note cursor stale fails the MIDI check
limits: Offline and private test processes only; tempo and sample-rate changes are refused; no real-time deadline or physical-audio measurement; the desktop does not use replacement yet (#54).
